description: Agent Tax Records: submit estimated tax payment records with the plan they answer to: the estimated payment record with its reference, the tax year, the stated method the estimates follow, the currency and each estimate period with its id, the period (such as 2026-Q1), the day the estimate is due and the amount the stated method sets; each estimated payment with its id, reference, the period it is paid against, the tax year it is paid toward, the day paid, the amount and any note on a difference from the stated method. The signed report gives the plan and the payments, each estimate period against the payments made against it, the payments for each period against its planned amount, each payment date against its period’s due date, and each payment’s period and tax year against the plan, and counts them, and names divergent estimated payments: a quarter with no estimate paid, estimate amounts that drift from the stated method with no note, an estimate dated after its due date, and an estimate paid against the wrong period or tax year; then an estimate period carrying two or more payments, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No estimate periods, no payments, no planned amount, no due date or no stated method leaves those points unverified. Periods match without case, punctuation or word order with quarters and month names folded, the payments against one period add together, a payment against the wrong period is set aside from the other reads, and amounts compare to the cent and dates by the day. This reads whether the estimated payments follow the plan the stated method sets, period by period. Verdict tax_estimate_divergent, tax_estimate_partial, tax_estimate_unverified or tax_estimate_consistent. POST /api/tax-estimate-check. Reads the tax records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it gives no tax advice, prepares or files nothing and decides nothing about anyone’s tax liability, which stay with the taxpayer and their tax professional, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Tax Records reads tax records: a filed return, tax payment records, sales tax records, withholding records, information returns, estimated payment records, deduction claims and tax authority notices, each against the books, schedules and deadline, the amounts the filed returns state as due, the stated rate and the sales tax remittances, the payroll record and the withholding remittances, the payment records, the periods and amounts the stated method sets, the support records, or the filed returns and responses it answers to. The family’s ground is the tax record set itself; the Agent Bookkeeping family reads the books the filings are drawn from, and this family reads the filings, payments and notices after they exist. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-tax-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-tax-records/.
